feedback.answered: Two confirmed results are recorded where they belong in the map. The promoted-leader variant of the recovery finding (claim C6) is added to the core overview's context: with IsLeader true the new ballot is raised past maxRecvBallot and the committed reply is still skipped, so the divergence applies to the replica the shipped configuration promotes. The dead rejection path (claim C7) is recorded in Behavior B5 and as an overview detail: the accept handler's ballot-equality gate precedes its nack branch, so a higher-ballot AcceptReply is ignored, and the pre-accept side has no rejection signal either because its reply copies the request's ballot, which leaves progress after a rejection to the 10s execution timeout.
remaining: the timeout-driven recovery path is not exercised by any check, so the delay's actual length in a deployed run is unmeasured
